author: Inside Edition
description: A furious driver exited his vehicle and unleashed a tirade against a black SUV ripping off the side-view mirror. The enraged man hurls it at the SUV's windshield. The black SUV then drove down the San Francisco street with the hothead clinging to the side of the car. The hothead has been identified as 49-year-old Alfredo Salvio Orosco and police later arrested him on suspicion of vandalism, making criminal threats and throwing an object at a vehicle. Police say his actions were “unprovoked.”
title: Furious Driver Unleashes Tirade Against Car

author: Inside Edition
description: A Florida man allegedly impersonating law enforcement, was busted when he tried to conduct a traffic stop. The Hillsborough County Sheriff says 46-year-old Nadi Jabari activated red and blue emergency lights in what they say was an attempt to stop a vehicle on a highway. Little did he know, he allegedly targeted an undercover sheriff's vehicle. Jabari was pulled over by real deputies, wearing real bodycams. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Allegedly Used Emergency Lights To Try To Pull Over Undercover Vehicle
